name: TwoTrees TTS-55 20W
tagline: 20W Ultra-budget diode with surprising build quality for the price
tldr: TwoTrees TTS-55 20W is the 20W SKU on the TwoTrees twotrees tts 55 line. TwoTrees undercuts Atomstack and Ortur on price while offering a usable 5. Verify optical power on the listing — do not assume combined-watt marketing.
mainObjective: Versatile hobby engraving with solid cutting through typical 3–6 mm basswood

priceRange.note: 20W optical module — verify SKU before buying

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

pros: Good companion if you already own TwoTrees 3D printers
cons: Open frame — full safety on you
May need alignment tweaks out of box
beginnerNotes: Choose 20W if it matches your typical jobs. Compare cut depth and price against other tiers in this product line before ordering.
proTips: Square the frame before first burn. Treat published max speed as aspirational — start at 50% for engraves until you dial settings in.
primaryUse: Bare-minimum budget diode for light engraving experiments and learning whether you enjoy the hobby.
